enabled.title: Capture enabled
enabled.description: Whether the extension captures chats at all. Locks the popup's Capture enabled switch.

retention.title: Content retention
retention.description: How much chat content is kept: full text, redacted text, or metadata only.

endpoint.title: Collector endpoint
endpoint.description: OTLP logs URL of the local Beacon collector. Must be on 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1].
